PowerPoint paragraphs with no explicit alignment default to LEFT, but these won't be included in the check. This could theoretically cause false positives if some text was never explicitly aligned. However, this is unlikely to be an issue in practice since the task metadata indicates all text starts with CENTER alignment (value=2), meaning all paragraphs likely have explicit alignment values.
